   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  CITY OF NORWALK PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
  July 9, 2026

Commissioner Anthony Armendarez called the meeting to order at 6:02 p.m.

Commission members present were Anthony Armendarez, David King, Antoinette
Moreno, Brian Tindall, and Don Valenzuela. Commissioner Maria Carbajal, Alejandra
Hernandez, Monique Yanez and Victor H. Juan were absent.
Staff present included Director of Recreation and Park Services Allan Perdomo,
Superintendent Sonia Batres, Engineer Mario Mera, Engineer Run Chen, and Office
Assistant II Vanessa Piceno.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Commissioner Moreno motioned to accept the June 11, 2026, meeting minutes.
Commissioner King seconded the motion. All in favor.
REPORTS

Hermosillo Park Water Infiltration Overview

Engineers Mario Mera and Run Chen, presented an overview of the Hermosillo Park
Water Infiltration system. The Commission received and filed the information. No action
was taken.

World Cup Viewing Party Re-cap

Recreation Superintendent, Sonia Batres, presented a re-cap of the World Cup Viewing
Party. The Commission received and filed the information. No action was taken.

Independence Day Festival Re-Cap

Recreation Superintendent, Sonia Batres, presented a re-cap of the Independence Day
Festival. The Commission received and filed the information. No action was taken.

Park Projects Monthly Update

Recreation and Park Services Director, Allan Perdomo, presented an update on current
and upcoming park improvement projects throughout the city. The Commission received
and filed the information. No action was taken.

STAFF COMMENTS
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting
Parks and Recreation Commission Meeting
July 9, 2026

Director Perdomo provided a summary of department program updates for the Parks
and Recreation Commissioners. Including that Parks and Rec Month activities are in full
swing. The Summer Concert series kicked off yesterday, July 8, 2026. The next
concerts will be on July 22, 2026 (Pop Vision Band) and August 5, 2026 (Banda Las
Angelinas). The department is coordinating a ribbon cutting ceremony for the installation
of the solar panels with a date to come soon.

COMMISISONER’S COMMENTS

Commissioner Valenzuela– Shared that he was impressed with the Hermosillo Park
Water Infiltration Overview presentation.

Commissioner Moreno – Emphasized that Holifield park needs laminated signs for the
restrooms to indicate that only toilet paper should be placed in the toilets.

Commissioner King – Requested that the department looks into the installation of a
portable dance floor for the remaining summer concerts.

Commissioner Tindall – Requested for the department to look into the tire swing and
missing benches at Glazier Park.

Commissioner Armendarez – Shared his appreciation for the recent events hosted by
the department, including the World Cup Viewing Party and Independence Day
celebration. He also requested that the department look into the tables at Gerdes Park
that have been marked with graffiti.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
NEXT MEETING
August 13, 2026

There being no further business to discuss, Commissioner Armendarez motioned to
adjourn the meeting. Seconded by Commissioner King. All in favor. The meeting was
adjourned at 7:50 p.m.

Respectfully submitted,

__________________________
Chairperson Victor H. Juan
